structured.reason: The requirement dictates behavior when a tool is explicitly named or when a call is required, but it does not specify error handling for invalid input types. Removing the TypeError for invalid inputs does not violate this requirement.
sources: When the caller explicitly selects a named tool, a supported provider route shall request and execute that tool rather than silently choosing another registered tool. When the caller requires a tool call without naming one, a supported provider route shall ask the provider to call one of the registered tools.
